verdict.rationale: Square provides an extensive, well-documented public REST API with catalog, inventory, orders, payments, webhooks, sandbox testing, and official SDKs (e.g., TypeScript SDK), plus an llms.txt for AI discoverability and even a dedicated MCP server for agentic access. This clearly enables AI-native users to programmatically drive the product. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404s) and independent hands-on developer corroboration beyond official docs.
